# ui-icon

> Icon component rendering SVG from the global icon registry.

**Class:** `UIIcon`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | Icon name from the Phosphor icon set |
| `size` | `string` | Icon size override |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible label (sets role="img" when present) |

## CSS Tokens

Public `--ui-*` custom properties consumed by this component:

- `--ui-icon-color`
- `--ui-icon-lg`
- `--ui-icon-md`
- `--ui-icon-size`
- `--ui-icon-sm`
- `--ui-icon-xl`
- `--ui-icon-xs`

## Usage

```html
<ui-icon></ui-icon>
```
